sheep.title: Vaccination of children unavoidable
sheep.details: Vaccinating children is also unavoidable in order to end the pandemic. It is also a question of intergenerational justice that children have access to the vaccines.

sheep.title: Vaccine Shedding Nonsense
sheep.details: That non-vaccinated people can be 'infected' by vaccinated people and should therefore stay away from them is nonsense. It is sad when they now start to follow hygiene rules like masks.

sheep.title: Vaccinating gives vitality
sheep.details: The vaccination gave me back strength and vitality. And I have had a feeling of lightness ever since that feels so good that I recommend others to get vaccinated soon.

sheep.title: Vaccinating sets you free
sheep.details: In addition to safety, the freedoms that are restored by politics after vaccination are reason enough to vaccinate. The refusers will then lead a life of deprivation.

sheep.title: Vaccinating means love
sheep.details: Vaccinating oneself is a question of solidarity with one's fellow human beings. The prospect of overcoming the pandemic with a joint effort should be enough to undergo this minor intervention.

sheep.title: Delta Variant Dangerous
sheep.details: The Indian mutant B1.617 is causing untold suffering in its country of origin and is currently spreading worldwide. This clearly shows that even at low incidences, neither the pandemic nor the risk to individuals is over.

sheep.title: Telegram dangerous
sheep.details: The Russian messenger Telegram, where criminals and Nazis hang out, is doubly dangerous: privacy is not taken very seriously there and nowhere is more false information spread. Do not use it under any circumstances!

sheep.title: Vaccinated are only simulating
sheep.details: People who have been sick for days after their vaccination are partly just malingerers. And it is also tempting to take a few days off after the vaccination.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated put others at risk
sheep.details: In the end, everyone must be vaccinated so that we can successfully defeat the virus. Everyone who is re-vaccinated is a permanent threat to everyone else, which can only be countered by isolation.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated make mutations
sheep.details: The virus not only spreads unhindered through unvaccinated people but can also mutate more. Therefore, every unvaccinated person increases the risk that new dangerous mutations will emerge and further prevent our return to normality.

sheep.title: Half-knowledge dangerous
sheep.details: Many critics are completely unjustifiably sure of their case and their arguments, as they are usually based on only half-knowledge. Only experts really have the full knowledge that enables them to assess the situation.

sheep.title: Politicians want re-election
sheep.details: The regulatory frenzy of politicians, which sometimes goes beyond the target, can also be explained simply by the fact that they want to be re-elected. They hope to achieve this by giving the majority a sense of security.

sheep.title: Chaos Theory Explains it
sheep.details: One needs only the chaos theory and no conspiracy theories to explain the crisis. In general, chaos and incompetence as the simplest explanation is the most likely.

sheep.title: Many more dead than official
sheep.details: The number of unreported corona deaths worldwide is certainly many times higher than the official figures suggest. Therefore, we can also assume that the risk for all of us is many times higher.

sheep.title: Travel irresponsible
sheep.details: People who still travel in the current crisis are behaving highly irresponsibly. Every traveler carries a risk of carrying viruses and viral mutations to or from other countries.

sheep.title: Refuting Bullshit Harder
sheep.details: Reasonable scientists and journalists cannot compete with the many, constantly new slanted claims and theories of the critics. Refuting bullshit requires a power of ten more energy than producing it.

sheep.title: Protests increase incidence
sheep.details: The people who are taking to the streets worldwide against the Corona measures are partly to blame for our failure to overcome the pandemic. Each new protest march without masks and distance increases the incidence.

sheep.title: Zoonotic diseases are on the rise
sheep.details: Because we are thoughtlessly overexploiting exotic animals, there will be even more spillovers of pathogens (zoonoses) in the future. This is just a natural 'lesson' for us humans.

sheep.title: Will endure vaccination
sheep.details: Even if the vaccination should be problematic: My immune system is strong enough to cope with the vaccination. The advantages, e.g. the possibility to travel again, clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

sheep.title: Vaxxing for travel
sheep.details: I don't necessarily want the vaccination, but if I'm otherwise not allowed to travel in the future, I'll make the sacrifice. After all, life is short and you should savor it.

sheep.title: Vaccinating protects the weak
sheep.details: Those who refuse vaccination, even though they have a healthy and strong body, do so to the detriment of the weak. Because even if the disease cannot harm you, it can harm someone weaker whom you could infect.

sheep.title: Not yet immune
sheep.details: Only after the pandemic will it be possible to live tolerably with the virus. We still have to wait until then, until the vast majority is immune to the virus.

sheep.title: Contact tracing solution
sheep.details: The best solution for living with the virus in the future with as little risk as possible is consistent contact tracking. Therefore, the use of appropriate apps should be mandatory.

sheep.title: Information Laziness
sheep.details: Critics who do not take the crisis seriously enough are often simply too lazy to inform themselves sufficiently. Unfortunately, this laziness can be their and others' undoing.

sheep.title: What can be done?
sheep.details: Even if the critics were right with their theories about the virus, the crisis and the vaccination, what would one have from this knowledge? If it really were a conspiracy, what can one do about it as an individual?

sheep.title: Virus natural
sheep.details: There is enough evidence that the virus is of natural origin and entered our world through zoonosis, i.e. the jump from an animal to a human. Claims that it could have come from a laboratory in Wuhan have no basis.

sheep.title: Chinaphobia
sheep.details: Claims that the virus originated in a laboratory in Wuhan and was deliberately sent into the world by the Chinese government must first be proven. Spreading it without proof only fuels hostility towards China.

sheep.title: Testing prevents outbreaks
sheep.details: The current testing strategy helps contain the virus because infected individuals can be detected and isolated more quickly through testing. We must also accept the sacrifice of fewer unnecessarily isolated false positives to achieve this.

sheep.title: Just money-making
sheep.details: The many lawyers around the world who promise to help people get their rights through lawsuits, for example in matters of unjustified measures, are just making money. People should think twice before investing their money in such lawsuits.

sheep.title: Supervised
sheep.details: We are all already transparent people for corporations and intelligence agencies. Those who are now painting a surveillance state like in China on the wall have not even realized the current situation.

sheep.title: Protesting egoists
sheep.details: Those who are now taking to the streets without masks and distance are just affluent egoists. They had better face up to the reality of the pandemic and submit so that we can all get our free lives back at some point.

sheep.title: I just don't believe
sheep.details: All these stories about some evil plans of dark forces are only speculations. One must always ask oneself the question about the sense. Why should they do that? What would they gain from it?

sheep.title: Explainable by profit
sheep.details: Almost everything that conspiracy theorists want to explain with complicated conspiracies can also be explained simply with the pursuit of profit. Currently hundreds of billions in the vaccination and testing business.

sheep.title: Ockham's razor
sheep.details: The principle of Occam's razor, which is common in science, can also be applied to the current situation: Of several possible explanations for the same state of affairs, the simplest theory is preferable to all others.

sheep.title: Close the gaps
sheep.details: If the whole world needs to be vaccinated to end the pandemic, rich countries must work to fund vaccines for the poor in Africa and elsewhere. This is the only way to close the vaccination gaps!

sheep.title: Adverse effects show effectiveness
sheep.details: The sometimes severe side effects experienced by vaccinated individuals after vaccination are a sign that strong immune protection is building up and are an unmistakable sign that the vaccination is taking effect.

sheep.title: Vaccination is responsibility
sheep.details: All those who vaccinate are making an important contribution to the common good and society as a whole. These people can be proud of themselves for making this small sacrifice for everyone.

sheep.title: No rights for the unvaccinated
sheep.details: Unvaccinated people who shirk their social responsibilities should not get back the freedoms that were curtailed to fight the crisis. This is also a strong incentive to reconsider their decision.

sheep.title: Bill Gates doesn't need money
sheep.details: The many insinuations and conspiracy accusations to which Bill Gates is exposed make no sense at all, because man already has so much money, he doesn't need any more.

sheep.title: All WHO claims
sheep.details: The uniform Corona policy and selection of measures worldwide has its basis in the guidelines and recommendations of the World Health Organization (WHO). Therefore, no hidden intentions can be imputed to the policy here.

sheep.title: New start urgently needed
sheep.details: The Great Reset, as planned by the members of the World Economic Forum, has no alternative. A new start is urgently needed in many areas in order to preserve our living space for the future.

sheep.title: Expropriate Pharmaceutical Patents
sheep.details: The real problem is that the pharmaceutical companies are making billions with these vaccines developed with taxpayers' money. The only sensible thing to do in this case would be to convert the patents into common property.

sheep.title: Vaccinated undesirables
sheep.details: In the U.S., vaccinated people are already being discriminated against in many states because people have been persuaded by fake news about infectious vaccines. This clearly shows that we need to get a better handle on misinformation.

sheep.title: No Harmful Substances
sheep.details: There are enough studies of masks and test kits that have shown that there are no toxins, contamination or harmful substances. You can rely on the safety structures here.

sheep.title: mRNA also anti-cancer
sheep.details: mRNA technology is a boon to humanity that will help fight many more diseases in the near future. Cancer is already in the works as the next use case.

sheep.title: One would have started in Africa
sheep.details: If mass vaccination were a population control measure, it would have started in Africa instead of in the industrialized nations. This fact already deprives the absurd thesis of any basis.

sheep.title: Adverse effects easy to report
sheep.details: Worldwide, vaccination side effects have been recorded in corresponding public registries for decades. These very straightforward reports therefore allow us to make a good estimate of the true proportion of side effects.

sheep.title: Relying on others
sheep.details: Opponents of vaccination are egoists who rely on the willingness of the vaccinated to take a tiny risk for the good of all. Because they refuse vaccination, we all have to hold out longer.

sheep.title: Politicians love power
sheep.details: Overly restrictive, perverse or excessive measures that politicians impose faster than they take them back are merely a sign of individuals' obsession with power.

sheep.title: Distributed among hospitals
sheep.details: The fact that the crisis has triggered fewer supply bottlenecks in countries with good healthcare systems, such as Germany, than in others is due to the even distribution of patients among the available hospitals.

sheep.title: No basic immunity
sheep.details: There is still no basic immunity in the population against the novel virus and its many mutations. Therefore, the vaccination campaign must be carried through to the end.

sheep.title: Everything has side effects
sheep.details: Everything, even supposedly harmless foods and medicines, has a certain probability of side effects. If you are brave enough for aspirin or chocolate, you can also get vaccinated against the virus.

sheep.title: Local outbreaks proof
sheep.details: The many local outbreaks of the virus, e.g. at parties, in businesses or in homes, which have been reported in the media, are proof enough of its dangerousness. We must always be aware of this risk.

sheep.title: Thromboses always happen
sheep.details: The risk of thrombosis exists in many contexts, such as flying, birth control pills, and corona disease. So far, thromboses occurring after vaccination have been rarer than in these contexts.

sheep.title: Died WITH not BY the vaccine
sheep.details: A large number of people die in the country every day. If the entire population gets vaccinated within a very short period of time, deaths after vaccination are statistically expected.

sheep.title: Protects against severe courses
sheep.details: Vaccination does not protect against infection with the virus, but it does protect against a severe course of the viral disease. This protection benefits oneself and also the community by helping to protect the healthcare system from overuse.

sheep.title: Cases only in the unvaccinated
sheep.details: Severe courses of corona are increasingly occurring only in the unvaccinated due to the ongoing vaccination campaign. Therefore, the unvaccinated put themselves and the health care system in unnecessary danger by their refusal.

sheep.title: Relaxing measures is an experiment
sheep.details: Repealing all policy-imposed measures is an irresponsible experiment. Measures on a certain scale have now become indispensable to protect the health care system.

sheep.title: Vaccinating children protect all
sheep.details: Vaccinated children help protect many other vulnerable groups from Corona infection, even without being one of them. Only with the solidary vaccination of the children we come to an effective vaccination rate.

sheep.title: Organ damage from Long Covid
sheep.details: Permanent organ damage such as heart muscle inflammation and cardiac arrhythmias, as well as lung damage and respiratory problems, are common diagnoses of Long Covid patients. Unfortunately, there is no reporting system for these long-term consequences.

sheep.title: Disinformation Dozen
sheep.details: Among the Corona fake news spreaders on the Internet, twelve people in particular have been identified. If the distribution channels of this 'disinformation dozen' were blocked, the crisis could be handled much better right away.

sheep.title: Every day a plane crash or 9/11
sheep.details: The Covid casualty figures are best placed in a disaster context like a plane crash to understand their magnitude. No one would want to maintain a situation like the current pandemic under these circumstances.

sheep.title: Sacrifice few to protect many more
sheep.details: The principle of vaccination has always been to sacrifice a few to save many. This is also the case with the Corona vaccine, and no one claims that there are no side effects at all, but only a vanishingly small number.

sheep.title: Vaccination makes more economic sense
sheep.details: From an economic point of view, the principle of vaccination is simply the more sensible solution in relation to the mass natural passing through of a disease. The aspect of sick leave should be included in decisions.

sheep.title: Dull criticism of capitalism
sheep.details: Criticism of the profits and contractual practices of the large vaccine manufacturers is only a dull, inappropriate critique of capitalism. In the medical context, where life and death are at stake, different standards must be applied.

sheep.title: mRNA technology has long been mature
sheep.details: The mRNA vaccine is a solution that has long since matured after many years of research. Only the studies were not continued because previous corona virus pandemics like SARS have ended on their own.

sheep.title: Locking out non-vaccinated people to protect them
sheep.details: Regulations to exclude the unvaccinated from social life, cultural events and stores also serve their own protection. After all, they can regain access at any time by being vaccinated.

sheep.title: No right to infect others
sheep.details: Unvaccinated people do not have to vaccinate themselves, but by not vaccinating they practically take away the right to infect others. Therefore, the state must ensure the physical integrity of others through isolation.

sheep.title: Doctors are trained
sheep.details: The dissenters typically do not have medical training to assess the correctness of the Corona measures supported by the vast majority of physicians. They should therefore be cautious about their views.

sheep.title: Doctors are experienced
sheep.details: The dissenters typically do not have the experience as physicians to assess the correctness of the Corona measures supported by the vast majority of physicians. They should therefore be cautious in their assessments.

sheep.title: Side effects are mild
sheep.details: Although there is a lot of talk about side effects of vaccination, this usually refers to mild side effects such as short-term pain in the arm or headaches. These effects can also be observed with other vaccinations.

sheep.title: Safety standards complied with
sheep.details: While the vaccines were developed in an accelerated process to get results faster, all safety standards were met in the process. Therefore, one can have confidence in them.

sheep.title: Sufficiently less contagious
sheep.details: Vaccinated people therefore no longer have to test themselves because they are sufficiently less contagious compared to unvaccinated people. Not having to be tested is also another incentive to vaccinate.

sheep.title: What pressure?
sheep.details: The alleged social pressure to vaccinate is in fact no pressure at all, but merely a sensible policy in the sense of epidemiology. Whoever refuses this cannot speak of repression.

sheep.title: Vaccinations greatest achievement
sheep.details: It is common knowledge that vaccination is one of the greatest medical achievements in human history. It is incomprehensible that so many people have turned away from this concept.

sheep.title: No right to eat in a restaurant
sheep.details: The restrictions on the unvaccinated are merely political measures to contain a pandemic. People cannot invoke their basic rights when they are excluded from restaurants and stores.

sheep.title: Do not want to contribute
sheep.details: Unvaccinated people do not care about our fate, they do not want to contribute to a normal life again. This shows how stupid and uneducated our society has become!

sheep.title: Fear of control = more control
sheep.details: In the end, the fear of state control in the Corona context only creates the prerequisite for the need for even more state control. This vicious circle can only be broken by obedience.

sheep.title: Seeing DNA change as an opportunity
sheep.details: Somewhat ironically, one could call out to the particularly illogical vaccination refusers: Those who believe that an mRNA vaccination would change their DNA had better see it as an opportunity!

sheep.title: 100% vaccination rate = 100% vaccinated sick people
sheep.details: The reference to vaccinated people who are also infected with the virus and treated in hospital makes little sense if large parts of the population have already been vaccinated. With a 100% vaccination rate, all sick people are also vaccinated.

sheep.title: Be calm, it'll soon be over
sheep.details: The pandemic will eventually be over, and until then we should just be more relaxed. With the great goal of ending the pandemic in mind, the measures will be much easier to endure.

sheep.title: Vaccines no long-term effects
sheep.details: The current Corona vaccines cannot have any negative long-term effects, if only because their principle of operation renders them ineffective in a short time. Concerns in this regard are unfounded.

sheep.title: Pharma companies communicates poorly
sheep.details: The pharmaceutical industry already does some 'crooked' things and communicates poorly. But to use that as a reason for refusal in the Corona context is inappropriate because it keeps us all stuck in the pandemic.

sheep.title: We only have to vaccinate everyone
sheep.details: If everyone were vaccinated, there would be significantly fewer infections and the healthcare system would be far from overloaded. With a maximum vaccination rate, we would have overcome the pandemic long ago.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated are threat
sheep.details: Within a pandemic, the unvaccinated are a threat to society, as their refusal makes it impossible to overcome the crisis together. Society therefore has a right to defend itself against them.

sheep.title: Not a doctor / scientist
sheep.details: Uu Corona Dissenters are not doctors or scientists and are therefore unable to see the complex situation. More trust in the knowledge and experience of the experts would be appropriate.

sheep.title: Don't know any
sheep.details: I do not know any who have serious side effects in their family and acquaintances. The problem may thus not be so relevant, at the same time I definitely know many Corona victims.

sheep.title: Do not allow the state to be blackmailed
sheep.details: The state must not allow itself to be blackmailed by the dissenters on Corona and their protest actions. In the pandemic, it must first and foremost ensure that the interests of the majority are enforced.

sheep.title: Exclusion is important
sheep.details: Excluding the unvaccinated from social life has an important educational function. They must be made aware that they are contributing to an unnecessary prolongation of the exceptional situation.

sheep.title: Side effects / vaccination deaths coincidence
sheep.details: Many people die every day. This fact alone also results in a probability of dying after a vaccination. We experience these as supposed side effects and vaccination deaths in connection with a high number of vaccinations.

sheep.title: Relaxations only with a high vaccination rate
sheep.details: The call for relaxations must not be followed because a high vaccination rate is a prerequisite for the withdrawal of measures. This relationship has been clearly demonstrated by field studies in other countries.

sheep.title: Just personal anecdotes
sheep.details: When people report side effects in themselves or in their environment, these are only personal anecdotes that cannot be generalized and have no statistical relevance.

sheep.title: Nothing happens with billions
sheep.details: If you include the side effect reports, virtually nothing has happened with billions of vaccinations. The advantages of the globally successful vaccination campaign clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated people get sick worse
sheep.details: The unvaccinated have been shown to contract corona the fastest and worst, and are more likely to end up in intensive care. They are thus more likely to become a burden on the healthcare system.

sheep.title: Delegitimization of the state by critics
sheep.details: The state must resist all attempts to be delegitimized by Corona critics. This danger exists especially if the executive branch does not take decisive action against violations of laws and regulations.

sheep.title: Not spreading nonsense is not one-sided
sheep.details: Media that refrain from spreading unsubstantiated information or even total nonsense do not automatically report in a one-sided manner. They are committed to certain quality standards that do not apply in Telegram.

sheep.title: Dunning-Kruger effect
sheep.details: The Dunning-Kruger effect works with dissenters. They are incompetent people who overestimate their own knowledge and are incapable of judging themselves objectively by means of metacognition.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated occupy places
sheep.details: Unvaccinated people fall ill more often and more severely during the pandemic, which results in a higher occupancy of hospital beds by them. These beds are no longer available for other patients.

sheep.title: State of the art
sheep.details: The image presented to the public on the crisis and its background is created by recourse to experts and represents the state of science. Everything else is unscientific sideshow.

sheep.title: You do not have the absolute truth
sheep.details: Many dissenters often appear so self-confident and convinced, as if they had the truth. One cannot take them seriously, if only because of their lack of self-criticism.

sheep.title: Self-proclaimed critics/journalists
sheep.details: Many pretentious and incompetent people appear in the Corona context as critics/journalists without having the necessary competences. These are rightly written down or ignored by the major media.

sheep.title: State cares, makes vaccinations free
sheep.details: The state cares for its citizens in the pandemic by providing vaccinations free of charge to all. It is ungrateful and selfish to refuse this offer for the benefit of all.

sheep.title: Defiance phase like with children
sheep.details: The negative attitude of vaccination opponents, often without any evidence, is strongly reminiscent of the defiant phase known from childhood, which one should actually have overcome in adulthood.

sheep.title: Do not reward the unsolid
sheep.details: Unsound behavior must not be further rewarded in the context of vaccination and interventions, otherwise the basic pillars of our society will be put at risk.

sheep.title: Higher contributions for vaccination refusers
sheep.details: Vaccine refusers are irresponsible with their bodies, comparable to couch potatoes or bungee jumpers. They are a burden on the community and should be charged higher premiums.

sheep.title: The government would never do that
sheep.details: I cannot imagine my own government being ruthless enough for such a far-reaching deception of its own people. The assumptions of the critics in this direction are unrealistic.

sheep.title: WITH but not ON: double standards
sheep.details: Just as one can argue that many have died not ON but WITH the virus, one can argue analogously that many have died not ON but WITH the vaccination. Who does not want to see this, measures with double standards.

sheep.title: Pandemic of the unvaccinated
sheep.details: The unvaccinated are largely responsible for the continuation of the pandemic, as they fall ill more frequently and more severely, thus overburdening the medical care structures. This is the pandemic of the unvaccinated!

sheep.title: Breakthroughs because not 100% protection
sheep.details: Vaccination breakthroughs can be explained because the vaccination just does not protect 100%. In particular, pre-existing conditions and other factors can greatly reduce its effectiveness.

sheep.title: Only non-vaccinated people in intensive care units
sheep.details: According to official data from hospitals, almost only unvaccinated patients are treated in intensive care units. If you want to relieve the intensive care units, you have to start with them!

sheep.title: The only thing missing is the next booster
sheep.details: The reason for the increase in covid cases even among vaccinated people is that their vaccination is already too far behind to be sufficiently effective. They just lack the booster to continue escaping the disease.

sheep.title: Zoo animals also already vaccinated
sheep.details: Meanwhile, even zoo animals are vaccinated against Corona. As an unvaccinated person, you don't want to be inferior to them and possibly belong to the last disease-prone creatures on earth.

sheep.title: Heart problems only imagined
sheep.details: Many people misinterpret signals from their own body due to misinformation on the net and imagine that they will have heart problems or similar after vaccination. People can also be unnecessarily frightened of such a harmless procedure.

sheep.title: In the past also 'suddenly and unexpectedly'
sheep.details: In the past, too, people died suddenly and unexpectedly. Now people blame vaccination for such cases because it fits better with their own point of view.

sheep.title: Critics just look for matching papers
sheep.details: Corona critics look for the appropriate scientific papers for their views on the net, without knowing the correct procedure, let alone being able to read the papers properly.

sheep.title: Own freedom stops with the others
sheep.details: The deliberately unvaccinated are a health hazard for everyone else around them. In their insistence on their freedoms, they overlook the fact that these freedoms end where the rights of others begin.

sheep.title: Vaccinated courage fills hospitals
sheep.details: Before vaccination, many people refrained from hospital visits for fear of infection. Now, with renewed courage, they are filling hospitals with many non-Corona-related cases.

sheep.title: All side effects also with Covid
sheep.details: All the potentially feared side effects of vaccination, including thrombosis, myocarditis, etc., occur much more frequently and with a more severe course with Covid infection. Clearly, one should be afraid of Covid infection.

sheep.title: Vaccinated are still not dead
sheep.details: That vaccinated people will die in a few months has probably turned out to be misinformation after all, because we vaccinated people are still not dead. Something must have gone wrong with this prognosis.

sheep.title: Functioning society only with commitment
sheep.details: You can't have everything without also giving something in return. There is no place for selfishness in a functioning society, and selfish people must be made to feel it.

sheep.title: Triage for non-vaccinated persons
sheep.details: I support triage for the unvaccinated, because anyone who doesn't get vaccinated now acts at their own risk and shouldn't be able to take a spot in the ICU away from anyone.

sheep.title: Egoism accusation freedom of speech
sheep.details: The accusation of selfishness against the deliberately unvaccinated naturally falls under the freedom of opinion which they themselves so vehemently propagate. Their indignation about it is therefore tantamount to a double standard.

sheep.title: Just a prick!
sheep.details: As it has always been true for vaccinations, it's just a little prick that you don't need to be afraid of. Even small children understand that!

sheep.title: Socialist compulsory vaccination has worked well
sheep.details: Compulsory vaccination could be a possible, restrictive way to overcome the pandemic if all other incentives for voluntary vaccination fail. This has already been done well in former socialist countries.

sheep.title: Who harms the majority => consequences
sheep.details: Anyone who makes a decision as an adult that potentially harms the majority society must also bear the consequences of this decision. We cannot afford to be considerate of egoists in a pandemic.

sheep.title: Vaccination myths are a problem for everyone
sheep.details: The many myths and conspiracy narratives circulating on the web keep many people from doing their part to overcome the pandemic. Therefore, it must be seen as a problem for all of us to fight.

sheep.title: If smallpox still had
sheep.details: All the misinformation on the Internet is preventing us from defeating the virus. Fortunately, the Internet has not been around that long, otherwise mankind would probably never have succeeded in eradicating polio and smallpox.

sheep.title: Side effects are immune reaction
sheep.details: Side effects do not result from the vaccination, but from the immune reaction triggered by it. The same immune reaction would also have occurred in the specific patient in the case of an infection.

sheep.title: Common good trumps self-determination
sheep.details: There are situations in which the common good outweighs self-determination and individual freedoms. The current pandemic and the worldwide vaccination campaign to overcome it are precisely such cases.

sheep.title: Dangerous horse dewormer
sheep.details: The ivermectin advertised by vaccination opponents is an unproven and therefore dangerous drug from veterinary medicine, which is used for deworming horses. One should urgently refrain from treating with it.

sheep.title: Compensation fund for vaccination damage
sheep.details: Appropriate compensation funds have long since been set up for the rare vaccination injuries that occur and have occurred as a result of mass vaccination. There is no insurance problem.

sheep.title: Breakthroughs in patients with severe pre-conditions
sheep.details: The protection provided by vaccination is high, but severe disease can still occur with risk factors such as pre-existing conditions, obesity or suppressed immune system. The vaccination can also not perform miracles.

sheep.title: Long experience with vaccinations
sheep.details: Mankind has hundreds of years of experience and success with the principle of vaccination behind it. In dealing with the current pandemic, we are all benefiting from this experience. And can be happy about it.

sheep.title: mRNA vaccination is known and safe
sheep.details: Research on mRNA vaccination has been going on for many decades and therefore side effects and problems are well known. The technology was ready in time for the pandemic and can be considered safe.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated people are pandemic drivers
sheep.details: The remaining unvaccinated pose a risk of infection to everyone else due to their higher susceptibility to the virus. As drivers of the pandemic, they must be kept away from the public.

sheep.title: Intensive care beds also need staff
sheep.details: The reference to free intensive care beds does not allow any statement about the real capacities, since personnel is always required to operate them. Looking at the number of beds alone is not meaningful.

sheep.title: Balancing of civil rights
sheep.details: Those who insist on their basic rights in times of pandemic overlook the right to health of their fellow human beings, which weighs just as much as the claimed rights - and which politicians must therefore weigh up.

sheep.title: Powerlessness against non-vaccinated people
sheep.details: The indignation of many vaccinated people because of the unvaccinated, who block the resolution of the pandemic with their refusal to vaccinate, is only understandable because of the perceived powerlessness in this situation.

sheep.title: Late effects not to be expected
sheep.details: Long experience with vaccinations shows that the feared side effects that first appear a long time after vaccination are not to be expected. As a rule, vaccinations take effect within a manageable period of time.

sheep.title: My vaccination prevented worse
sheep.details: I did go through covid after vaccination, but it would have been much worse if I had not been vaccinated. I am glad to have been vaccinated.

sheep.title: Asymptomatic transmission also with herpes
sheep.details: The effect of assymptomatic transmission is not at all as far-fetched as critics keep making it out to be, but also occurs in other diseases such as herpes.

sheep.title: Individual responsibility
sheep.details: I feel a personal responsibility for immunocompromised or -suppressed colleagues and relatives and therefore - and not because of my own risk - I adhere to the prescribed measures.

sheep.title: False adverse event reports
sheep.details: Vaccination opponents flood the adverse reaction reporting system with false reports, just as they have been shown to influence media surveys. Therefore, no conclusions should be drawn from the high reporting figures.

sheep.title: Denmark's about-face?
sheep.details: What about Denmark's about-face after their Freedom Day? I guess it's not as easy to return to normality as the critics always wish.

sheep.title: How to drive drunk
sheep.details: Refusing to vaccinate without good reason is like driving drunk, since you are endangering not only yourself but others as well. Sober people also cause accidents, but the probability is lower.

sheep.title: Breakthroughs only in risk groups
sheep.details: Vaccination breakthroughs are not a general phenomenon, but affect mainly risk groups with pre-existing conditions. This is understandable, as vaccination can have less effect here than in healthy people.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated people take society hostage
sheep.details: By insisting on their freedom and self-determination over their bodies, the unvaccinated take the sensible rest of society hostage. Because of their attitude, a return to normality is not possible.

sheep.title: No treatment for non-vaccinated persons
sheep.details: The unvaccinated, because they knowingly take the greater risk of falling ill and possibly burdening the health care system in the process, must come to terms with being treated as the very last in an overuse situation.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated occupy beds
sheep.details: Unvaccinated people occupy hospital beds and thus use up the reserves early. As a result, the responsible, vaccinated rest of the population must endure the measures that would not otherwise have been necessary.

sheep.title: Financial participation of non-vaccinated persons
sheep.details: Consideration should be given to ways in which the unvaccinated can contribute financially to the costs of the ongoing pandemic. They are incurred by society as a whole, but are caused by refusal to vaccinate.

sheep.title: Lax controls irresponsible
sheep.details: In the catering and club sector, compliance with the rules is often not properly controlled and this can lead to outbreaks again and again. More control of the controllers with severe penalties!

sheep.title: Side effects rate normal
sheep.details: When the side effects of the Corona vaccine are put in relation to the quantities vaccinated - to billions of people - their proportion becomes vanishingly small - and the risks become comparable to those of classical vaccines.

sheep.title: Compensation solution is long since in place
sheep.details: As with all other recommended vaccines, there is already a state compensation scheme. So you are already covered against the risk of becoming a victim of a very rare side effect.

sheep.title: Liability exemption makes vaccination possible
sheep.details: The exemption from liability for vaccine manufacturers is what makes the successful fight against pandemics possible in the first place. If politicians had insisted on manufacturer liability for damages, we would have no vaccines!

sheep.title: Virus contact inevitable
sheep.details: In the next three years, it is very likely that everyone will come into contact with the virus. Then one is either dead or recovered, as vaccinated rather the latter.

sheep.title: Duties convince the unwilling
sheep.details: Other areas of life with corresponding risks show that unwilling people can only be convinced by obligations. A good example of this is the obligation to wear seat belts and helmets in road traffic.

sheep.title: Spain and Portugal successful
sheep.details: The numbers are lower or falling in countries like Spain and Portugal with high vaccination rates. Their vaccination programs successfully contained the pandemic and are therefore a model for other countries.

sheep.title: Test exemption required as motivation
sheep.details: The test exemption for vaccinated people is not conclusive, because they can still be infectious. But that is a matter of consideration: The exemption is again as a motivation and incentive to vaccination absolutely sensible.

sheep.title: Side effects rarer than lightning strike
sheep.details: The risk of fatal side effects from vaccination is lower than being struck by lightning. Fears are therefore irrational and do not do justice to the real probabilities.

sheep.title: After a few days through the body
sheep.details: The active ingredients of the vaccination are already out of the body a few days or weeks after the injection. And also do not act further than a few centimeters from the injection site.

sheep.title: Cannot penetrate cell nucleus
sheep.details: The administered genetic information in the mRNA or vector vaccines does not penetrate into cell nuclei. Therefore, there is also no possibility that one's own genetic information could be altered by the vaccination.

sheep.title: Adverse event reports can be duplicates
sheep.details: Portals automatically transfer data on adverse events and do not check the reports. The data there are not reliable, since anyone can report something there as often as they want.

sheep.title: So far only lucky with mutations
sheep.details: So far, we humans have only been lucky during the pandemic that no really dangerous mutations have emerged. Things can get much worse if the virus becomes significantly more deadly or contagious than before.

sheep.title: Covid deaths not registered
sheep.details: Many covid victims who died in private, who were not hospitalized and who did not undergo testing, constitute an unreported number that skews the statistics heavily in the positive.

sheep.title: Omicron variant
sheep.details: The mutation B.1.1.529 or Omikron combines the dangerousness of several other mutations. The danger of this variant for the health care system stems in particular from its high infection rate.

sheep.title: Politics has failed
sheep.details: We would have overcome the pandemic in our own country long ago if politics had not failed. The main causes are a lack of or too lax laws and regulations and insufficient government crackdowns on refuseniks.

sheep.title: Refused tests on Covid deaths
sheep.details: Families of the deceased often enforce that no test be done or that Covid not be on the death certificate to save themselves the hassle and restrictions of a Covid burial. This distorts the statistics.

sheep.title: Covid victim despite negative test
sheep.details: Patients who are negative again weeks after the disease can still die from the damage it caused. Covid had better always be assumed as the cause of death if there was a positive test before death.

sheep.title: Vaccination boosts male fertility
sheep.details: Covid vaccination improves the sperm quality of the male. Thus, it has no negative but even positive effects on male fertility!

sheep.title: Corona infection worsens fertility
sheep.details: A passed infection with the coronavirus can damage the sexual health of the man. This is another reason why vaccination is a sensible protective measure.

sheep.title: Statistics of one
sheep.details: People usually base their assessment of risks on their own experience. The fact that they are not ill or that there are no victims in their own environment gives them a false sense of security.

sheep.title: Telegram Fates Are Fake
sheep.details: The many fates of side effect victims communicated via alternative media channels such as Telegram are typically fabricated. Official, verified sources are better for assessing the real situation.

sheep.title: Current excess mortality is 'post-harvest'
sheep.details: The significant excess mortality since vaccination campaigns began has nothing to do with vaccination. Rather, the casualties are the natural 'after-harvest' of the closed period created by the previous lockdowns.

sheep.title: No correlation for side effects
sheep.details: The causal relationship to vaccination cannot be established for most side effects. Diseases and also deaths in a temporal context can be explained as statistical coincidence by the immense number of vaccinations.

sheep.title: Young people not invulnerable
sheep.details: Currently, many young people consider themselves invulnerable to the virus and therefore even provoke an infection. However, this is a fallacy that many will pay for with their health or even their lives.

sheep.title: Non-vaccinated people are a risk for all
sheep.details: Unvaccinated people play with the risk of all, because even a negative test does not protect them from catching the virus. And that they then fall ill, possibly blocking an intensive care bed that an accident victim urgently needs.

sheep.title: Basic trust in processes
sheep.details: It is paradoxical that people in crisis abandon their trust in some tried-and-tested mechanisms, but cling to them in other areas. The lack of common ground makes them difficult if not impossible to reach.

sheep.title: The world is as it seems
sheep.details: It is safe to assume that the world out there is as it appears and conspiracies are much more difficult than many think. After all, different interests are difficult to reconcile and agreements are hard to keep secret.

sheep.title: Expertise has its meaning
sheep.details: Not everyone can be knowledgeable in all areas and it therefore makes sense in the rules to rely on experts instead of overestimating oneself. This division of tasks is what makes our complex world controllable in the first place.

sheep.title: Dangerous to the state
sheep.details: Some of the critics of Corona's policies no longer believe in the structures and mechanisms of democracy and act in an openly anti-state manner. The state must take more rigorous action against these people to protect the majority.

sheep.title: Aspiration not necessary
sheep.details: Aspiration before vaccine injection is not necessary, according to official recommendations, because the blood vessels in the upper arm muscle within reach of the needle are too small for accidental intravascular administration.

sheep.title: Pandemics are not a novelty
sheep.details: In the history of mankind there have always been pandemics, e.g. the Spanish flu, so why not in our time? Currently, the probability of a pandemic is possibly even higher, given the way people act.

sheep.title: Recurring vaccinations have been around for long
sheep.details: Calling corona booster vaccinations a vaccine subscription or trap suggests that it is a novel feature. In contrast, there have long been recurrent vaccinations, such as the flu vaccine or the tick repellent vaccine.

sheep.title: Of course the pandemic is exploited
sheep.details: The crisis situation that the pandemic represents worldwide is, of course, being exploited by many interest groups. But this does not necessarily mean that they have also brought about the crisis in the form of an unrealistic, comprehensive conspiracy.

sheep.title: Moral obligation to vaccinate
sheep.details: Because the crisis can only be overcome with joint effort and joint sacrifice, a kind of moral inoculation obligation applies. Those who exempt themselves may be confronted with this moral violation by their fellow human beings.

sheep.title: Darwin Award for non-vaccinated people
sheep.details: The sarcastic negative award for people who harm or kill themselves through their own fault, showing a special degree of stupidity, should also be given to the group of unvaccinated people.

sheep.title: Omicron not a wave but a wall
sheep.details: In the case of the new Omikron variant, its high rate of infection means that we no longer have to speak of an epidemic wave but already of a wall that has the potential to severely overburden the healthcare system.

sheep.title: Politics again and again the same mistakes
sheep.details: It is true that a nationwide lockdown is not always appropriate, and sometimes tough regional restrictions are enough. But if it says lockdown, it must be lockdown, because we have enough half-hearted policies.

sheep.title: Kennedy was always a nutcase
sheep.details: Robert F. Kennedy, one of the central figures for the dissenters, has been an irrational opponent of vaccination and a self-proclaimed child protector since before the crisis. Therefore, there is no reason to trust him now.

sheep.title: Athletes also collapsed earlier
sheep.details: Athletes have always been at risk due to severe physical stress. Without reliable comparative figures from the past, no assessment of athlete collapse is possible.

sheep.title: Vaccination victims only suspected cases
sheep.details: All cases reported in the adverse event databases are only suspected cases. A causal relationship to vaccination cannot be established with certainty, so that these figures do not allow any conclusions to be drawn about the proportion of vaccine injuries.

sheep.title: Vaccine doses ordered for the third world
sheep.details: The many vaccines pre-ordered en masse by the EU and other major nations are expected to be made available to poorer countries in the future. They show no alleged plans for a longer duration of the pandemic.

sheep.title: Clearly a mass psychosis
sheep.details: The arguments of the Corona critics have meanwhile the character of a mass psychosis with delusions of totalitarian world domination and vaccination conspiracies. This psychosis is mainly fueled by beneficiaries.

sheep.title: Now everything's a vaccine side effect
sheep.details: Critics of vaccination now seem to interpret every health change in their environment as a vaccination side effect. They ignore the fact that there are coincidences and also that people age and decline in health.

sheep.title: Compulsory vaccination helps save face
sheep.details: In the meantime, many critics of vaccination have hardly any opportunity to move away from their position and save face. A vaccination obligation helps these people to get out of the blockade attitude by the state default.

sheep.title: Vaccine remains in your arm
sheep.details: The vaccine cannot be responsible for many alleged side effects at all, since it remains in the arm of the vaccinated person. It is probably a coincidental encounter rather than vaccine effects.

sheep.title: Refreshers useful until the end of the pandemic
sheep.details: Every individual can contribute to a quick end of the pandemic by following the official recommendations for boosters. Since the effect is limited, boosters are useful until the end of the pandemic.

sheep.title: Relatively few vaccination breakthroughs
sheep.details: The highlighting of vaccination breakthroughs by critics serves only to question the effectiveness of vaccination. In reality, there are very few such breakthroughs in relation to the total number of people vaccinated.

sheep.title: Rapid approval to contain the pandemic
sheep.details: The much-criticized fast-track vaccine testing and approval process was necessary to contain a global pandemic. This speed saved the world from a much worse course of the crisis.

sheep.title: Omicron could end pandemic
sheep.details: The omicron variant that now prevails, with its much milder course, may spell the end of the pandemic, as it is similar to influenza in its dangerousness. Policymakers could now focus on acceptance of the risk.

sheep.title: Anti-Vaxers in the 19th century
sheep.details: The rejection of vaccinations already existed with the smallpox vaccination in 19th century Europe. Then, as now, people were led astray by irrational fears and unscientific claims.

sheep.title: Infection is dirty immunization
sheep.details: Direct infection with the virus without prior vaccination protection is a kind of risky, dirty immunization. It can be done, but vaccination the safe and clean way to your own immunization.

sheep.title: Vaccination signals acceptance of the measures
sheep.details: The fact that the vast majority of people worldwide opt for vaccination is a clear signal of approval for government protection measures and regulations. Critics, on the other hand, mobilize only a tiny part of the population.

sheep.title: No real discrimination
sheep.details: The discrimination through social exclusion claimed by vaccination critics is in fact none at all, since vaccination status is not an immutable characteristic like homosexuality and skin color.

sheep.title: I trust the science
sheep.details: The vast majority of scientists share a unified view on the danger of Corona and on vaccination. These representatives of science should be trusted more than the isolated critics.

sheep.title: Corona shrinks the Penis
sheep.details: One of the possible long-term consequences of Corona infection for men is the reduction of their penis size. Surely this risk must be reason enough to protect oneself from this fate by vaccination!

sheep.title: Side effects often nocebo effect
sheep.details: Many vaccination side effects such as headaches are actually results of the nocebo effect, i.e. they are not caused by the vaccination, but by negative expectations of the vaccinated person due to widespread fear stories!

sheep.title: Heart muscle inflammation also infection
sheep.details: Myocarditis is also caused by infection with Covid. Such a diagnosis can therefore also result from a previous Corona infection and does not have to be a vaccination side effect.

sheep.title: Vaccination protects at-risk patients
sheep.details: The collective vaccination of the population makes sense because it protects patients at risk who cannot vaccinate themselves. This small act of consideration is not too much to ask!

sheep.title: Vaccination strengthens the immune system
sheep.details: Vaccination is currently the best way to prepare one's immune system for pathogens and thus to strengthen it. In contrast, trying to strengthen one's immune system by going through an illness is a strategy that makes little sense.

sheep.title: Diseases weaken the immune system
sheep.details: Diseases, especially covid, weaken the immune system instead of strengthening it, contrary to common belief. They should therefore be avoided, for example by getting vaccinated against them.

sheep.title: Vaccination is mandatory in health care
sheep.details: For employees who work in the health care sector, a vaccination obligation is being introduced worldwide, and quite rightly so. This is a very clear protective measure out of responsibility for patients.

sheep.title: Overcome needle phobia!
sheep.details: Many unvaccinated people are dealing with irrational fears from their childhood. They should overcome their doctor phobia or even their needle phobia to get us all out of this mess.

sheep.title: PIMS risk for children high
sheep.details: For children in particular, the risk of contracting MIS/PIMS after contracting Corona is very high. So in addition to protection of others, self-protection is also a good reason to vaccinate children.

sheep.title: There are so beautiful masks
sheep.details: In the meantime, there are so many beautiful motifs and colors for the medical masks, just like in the beginning with the fabric masks. So your own safety must be so at least no longer an aesthetic problem.

sheep.title: Already used to masks
sheep.details: I have become accustomed to the masks in recent years and feel comfortable with them. Therefore, I will probably continue to use this protection after the pandemic.

sheep.title: No lipstick needed because of masks
sheep.details: I like the masks because you have to invest less effort in make up and lipstick and can generally hide yourself and your flaws behind it. So the masks have like so like everything also a good side.

sheep.title: Booster is valid indefinitely
sheep.details: Despite the technical certificate validity of twelve months, the booster booster vaccination is valid indefinitely. One should not be put off by the whispers about a lifetime vaccination subscription.

sheep.title: Normal signs of aging
sheep.details: Physical problems that many people consider to be side effects of vaccination are actually normal symptoms of aging. They give a distorted picture of perceived side effects.

sheep.title: For research Corona was good
sheep.details: The pandemic has decisively advanced new technologies for disease treatment such as mRNA vaccines. We will benefit from this for many other diseases in the future.

sheep.title: More cancer is pandemic consequence
sheep.details: The increasing number of cancer cases is a result of the pandemic, as fewer people go for screening, surgeries and treatments are postponed, and follow-up care suffers as well. The cancer has nothing to do with the vaccinations.

sheep.title: Risks higher for the unvaccinated
sheep.details: The risks in terms of disease and disease progression are demonstrably higher for the unvaccinated than for the vaccinated. This is another reason why it is irrational to refuse vaccination.

sheep.title: Silent Triage
sheep.details: Direct triage is rare in hospitals, but due to the pandemic, silent triage has long been taking place for other conditions such as cancer. This is another reason why the pandemic urgently needs to be overcome.

sheep.title: Vaccination refusal often childhood trauma
sheep.details: The rejection of vaccination by many people is not rationally justified, but is due to childhood traumas. However, global health security cannot be made dependent on such individual characteristics.

sheep.title: Omicron mainly affects unvaccinated people
sheep.details: Although the omicron variant is more contagious and less dangerous, it primarily affects the unvaccinated. These are therefore partly responsible for the fact that we must continue to protect our healthcare system through measures taken by all.

sheep.title: Not to be taken seriously because of other areas
sheep.details: I can't take you or certain critics' voices on Corona seriously, because they are already completely off the mark in other areas, e.g. climate change or the gender issue.

sheep.title: Do not be of the same opinion as...
sheep.details: You can't seriously be of the same opinion as person XY because you don't want to have anything in common with this person. That is a logically understandable reason for a rejection.

sheep.title: You know the truth, but experts don't?
sheep.details: Do you really think that you, as a layman, know the truth better than the majority of experts worldwide? That is already quite a presumption, more humility would be appropriate here.

sheep.title: Will get vaccinated against everything
sheep.details: For me, the Corona vaccination is a natural choice, as I am very successful in basically accepting all opportunities for vaccination and disease prevention.

sheep.title: Vaccination protects children from MIS/PIMS
sheep.details: Vaccination protects children not only from severe courses, but also from the covid aftereffects of multisystemic inflammatory syndrome in organs such as the skin, heart, gastrointestinal tract, mucous membranes, lungs, liver, and kidneys.

sheep.title: Pandemic of violence
sheep.details: Aggressive mask refusers and vaccination opponents pose a daily risk to those who must sacrifice themselves and enforce Corona rules. Thousands of injuries and deaths worldwide show who is the aggressor.

sheep.title: Canadian truckers danger for all
sheep.details: The trucker protest in Canada represents only a small minority in relation to the total population. The country must not allow this minority to hold its supply and delivery structures to ransom.

sheep.title: Novavax is the alternative
sheep.details: Those who refuse vaccination because of the novel mRNA technology now have an alternative classical vaccine available in the form of Novavax. This means that there is no longer any reason to refuse vaccination.

sheep.title: State capitulates to those willing to be vaccinated
sheep.details: If those willing to vaccinate manage to escape the appeals and restrictions, the state will have given up in the fight against the pandemic. If rules are hardly controlled or revoked by courts, this will pay off in the end.

sheep.title: More and more vaccination opponents decide to
sheep.details: More and more opponents of vaccination are now deciding in favor of vaccination for a variety of reasons. We should follow their example and provide ourselves with effective protection.

sheep.title: First crisis experience for many
sheep.details: For many, the pandemic is the first time they have experienced a crisis in society as a whole. For some, it is the first time they have had the unpleasant experience that there are events that neither a leading state nor they themselves can control so easily.

sheep.title: Critics are spoiled by affluence
sheep.details: Many who rebel against the pandemic policy are only spoiled by their previous, self-determined lives. They do not see that the changes are due to necessary hygiene and disease control.

sheep.title: Leaving the ground of rationality
sheep.details: Constructive debate is no longer possible with the majority of critics because of their positions. The prerequisite for a discourse would be to first return to a rational discussion.

sheep.title: Resistance is selfish theater
sheep.details: The majority of people act rationally, the resistance against the pandemic policy, on the other hand, is only a selfish theater of a minority. This minority has only elevated the whole thing to a fight for freedom.

sheep.title: Resistance is pent-up frustration
sheep.details: For many critics, the crisis was only the trigger for releasing personally pent-up frustration, which, however, has other, private and social causes. In resistance, one can now finally release this frustration.

sheep.title: Vaccination is not a guarantee
sheep.details: Nothing has ever been guaranteed with any vaccination. It is always only a matter of improving chances and probabilities. Perfect effectiveness exists only in theory.

sheep.title: Vaccinated have done their duty
sheep.details: Those who have had themselves vaccinated have done their social duty. Now the opponents of vaccination must follow suit if they want to continue to claim their social rights.

sheep.title: Feelings are not facts
sheep.details: Critics of the pandemic policy base many of their views on feelings rather than facts. Political or journalistic balance is difficult when one side sticks to facts and the other to feelings.

sheep.title: Lifetime stolen by the unvaccinated
sheep.details: I was stolen a part of my lifetime by the unwillingness of the unvaccinated and the consideration of the policy on it. And now I want it back again!

sheep.title: Hygiene is the basis of civilization
sheep.details: Hygiene has brought mankind to where it is now against many problems. The hygiene measures in the crisis will also now bring us out of a major problem.

sheep.title: Physical integrity abused
sheep.details: The principle of physical integrity is appropriated by the critics against vaccination - from where it is really existential. In the process, the integrity of those infected is always ignored.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated fall for quacks
sheep.details: Many unvaccinated people think they can achieve a level of protection equivalent to vaccination by strengthening their immune system. In doing so, they fall for all sorts of recommendations from quacks.

sheep.title: Social cohesion is lacking
sheep.details: Cohesion in this country is broken in the long run. Personally, I have a hard time sitting down at a table with people who let themselves be taken over by right-wingers, who have crazy theories, and who lack solidarity.

sheep.title: Acceptance of scientific findings
sheep.details: The scientific consensus has a higher value than opinions and interpretations. With the reference to freedom of opinion, no aberrant nonsense may be sold as science.

sheep.title: Elimination of masks would bring deaths
sheep.details: If the mask requirement is withdrawn, we must expect thousands of additional deaths. Among them, especially vaccinated risk patients and those who are not allowed or not able to be vaccinated through no fault of their own.

sheep.title: Too much emphasis on rights
sheep.details: Critics place the emphasis in their arguments on individual rights and too little on obligations to the community. Rights and duties, however, must always be balanced.

sheep.title: Corona does not go away from talking
sheep.details: Critics should realize that corona is a medical problem, not a sociological one. UEs Will not go away from talking and listening, but only through massive and targeted government action.

sheep.title: Older generation disappointed
sheep.details: The older generation, to whom we owe a great deal, is experiencing a great deal of disappointment with the conduct of the 'I'm against everything' faction. In the crisis, respect for old age has been lost among some.

sheep.title: Corona can kill the unborn
sheep.details: Pregnant women wait for the birth out of fear of harming the unborn child before getting vaccinated. This is not only demonstrably unfounded but also potentially life-threatening for the unborn child.

sheep.title: Comparison of victim numbers is clear
sheep.details: Corona kills and vaccination helps to reduce this danger massively. The comparison of how many people have died worldwide from corona and from vaccination makes any discussion about what is right and what is wrong unnecessary.

sheep.title: It depends on the virus evolution
sheep.details: The fate of all of us will depend on the evolution of the coronavirus in the next few years. If it brings significantly fewer disease-causing variants to predominance, we will be out of the pandemic!

sheep.title: Not vaccinating is endangering child welfare
sheep.details: Depriving one's own children of vaccination is a dangerous act that society should not tolerate. The state should use its means to take action against parents for endangering the welfare of children.

sheep.title: There is no split
sheep.details: There is no division in the population. Only a few confused people are facing a large majority of reasonable people who are dealing with each other objectively, on a reasonable democratic basis.

sheep.title: Individuals do not behave reasonably
sheep.details: I am well informed through my media, and do not need links or information on the Corona topic. I also take great care to read only well-documented information from trustworthy media.

sheep.title: Still infected shortly before vaccination
sheep.details: Many people who fall ill or even die shortly after their vaccination or booster have simply been vaccinated or boosted too late - and thus became infected shortly before their vaccination.

sheep.title: Individuals do not behave reasonably
sheep.details: We should abandon the idea that individuals behave rationally. Instead of following this wishful thinking, the state would do better to relieve individuals of decisions that are important for the community.

sheep.title: Is like ignoring red lights
sheep.details: Those who see controls and tests as state coercion also ignore red traffic lights, since the state only prevents you from driving quickly with them. They are not needed anyway, if everyone pays attention.

sheep.title: He is also just an employee
sheep.details: Those who enforce measures in the corporate sector, such as in restaurants, are just employees who have to do it. You don't seriously want them to lose their jobs because of their own refusal.

sheep.title: Get small business owners in trouble
sheep.details: By refusing measures such as masks, you only get those who have to enforce them into trouble. As a rule, these are small businesses that are not responsible for any of this.

sheep.title: In this case totally understandable
sheep.details: In this particular situation - queue, buffet, etc.. - it is totally understandable if people have to wear masks. One should have prescribed this also always, in order to protect us all against pathogens of others.

sheep.title: Inconsiderate to the elderly
sheep.details: By refusing to take measures, one behaves recklessly and, in the worst case, is even directly or indirectly responsible for the death of elderly or immunocompromised people. Nobody can want that!

sheep.title: Everything is already strongly loosened
sheep.details: Politicians have long since reduced the measures to a barely noticeable level so that we can all live as comfortably as possible. The remaining rules are really no reason to rebel.

sheep.title: This is good for humanity
sheep.details: It is also good for mankind to be slowed down by the Corona crisis. It should be taken as an impetus to stop the overexploitation of nature and to start a sustainable economy.

sheep.title: Doctors vaccinate their own children
sheep.details: A large part of the doctors vaccinates not only themselves but also their own children against Corona before the release. So you can really assume a meaningful protection with the vaccination.

sheep.title: We have much bigger problems
sheep.details: We humans have much bigger problems than Corona, e.g. climate change, wars, etc. So one should not demonstrate against harmless Corona measures but instead for the solution of these big problems.

sheep.title: Does not want conflicts
sheep.details: I go along with the measures like wearing masks mainly to avoid conflicts with other people. That way, it's much easier to get through the crisis.

sheep.title: Does not want to be registered by the state
sheep.details: I am also critical of one or the other element of Corona's policy, but I prefer to stay under the radar to avoid being registered by the state.

sheep.title: Anti-vaxxers devalue everything
sheep.details: The general opposition to any vaccination, whose representatives mingle among the protests, completely devalues the justified criticism of measures. One should not take to the streets together with them.

sheep.title: Already gives compulsory vaccinations
sheep.details: Compulsory vaccination against Corona is not special, as there have been compulsory vaccinations for a long time. This obligation is usually well justified with the risk and the danger of the disease.

sheep.title: Is bad for all of us
sheep.details: Those who complain about their own existential limitations due to the measures should realize that everyone has to cut back - and we can only get out of the crisis together.

sheep.title: The children do so beautifully
sheep.details: The children help nevertheless so beautifully in the schools and kindergartens with the many solidary measures like masks and distances to master the crisis. There one can still have hope for the future of mankind.

sheep.title: Uses right vocabulary
sheep.details: By using politically right-wing vocabulary such as 'mainstream media' or 'puppets', one makes oneself mean and untrustworthy with their views. One can also criticize without such references.

sheep.title: Personalization of capitalist relations
sheep.details: Holding people like Uğur Şahin or Bill Gates personally responsible for exploiting the crisis is just a deliberate personalization of the system. In this way, nothing changes in the capitalist relations.

sheep.title: To make fear was right
sheep.details: Politicians did scare the population in many places during the crisis, but this approach was the right one. Without such campaigns, people simply would not have taken the crisis seriously.

sheep.title: Omikron BA.2 variant
sheep.details: The omicron variant BA.2 has a fitness advantage and is therefore even more contagious than the original variant. We will probably have to ward them off for a longer time through targeted measures.

sheep.title: Children have lost parents
sheep.details: Many children worldwide have lost their parents to Corona and are now on their own. Corona measures are there precisely to prevent such suffering by acting in solidarity.

sheep.title: Children contagious without sypmtoms
sheep.details: Children regularly have the highest incidence levels and can thus become super-spreaders completely without symptoms. Therefore, tests and masks in schools and kindergartens are sensible protective measures.

sheep.title: Corona can shrink the brain
sheep.details: Covid infection can result in brain damage. In particular, the gray matter responsible for emotions and memory shrinks, and the sense of smell can also suffer permanent damage.

sheep.title: In previous epidemics, the vaccine would have been welcomed
sheep.details: In past epidemics and pandemics, such as the Spanish flu, people would have welcomed having an effective vaccine. Today, they are simply behaving irrationally when they reject one.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated have higher viral load
sheep.details: Segregation and unequal treatment of the unvaccinated is justified because they have a higher viral load when they fall ill. They are simply more contagious and thus more dangerous for their fellow human beings than vaccinated persons.

sheep.title: Belief in conventional medicine
sheep.details: When it comes to Corona, I have complete faith in conventional medicine. It simply gives you a good feeling to be treated in case of illness by someone who has gone to 'school', i.e. has been properly trained.

sheep.title: Alternative media are like alternative medicine
sheep.details: Alternative media relate to established media somewhat like alternative medicine to conventional medicine. Alternative media can therefore not be taken seriously, just as homeopathy is not taken seriously.

sheep.title: Recombinant threatens
sheep.details: We are threatened by a viral recombinant of a dangerous and a contagious variant, which may lead to a crisis of even greater proportions. We should therefore be careful and not become lax in our protective measures.

sheep.title: Without measures, there is a risk of contamination
sheep.details: The omission of measures such as mandatory masks always carries the risk that the virus will spread to large parts of the population. Then we would have a contagion, which no one can seriously want.

sheep.title: You can not fool so many people
sheep.details: The thesis that we are all being led around by the nose with the virus is simply not comprehensible. It is completely unrealistic that so many people can be deceived in this way.

sheep.title: Do not want to jeopardize my vacation
sheep.details: I am vaccinated, but I still avoid parties and wear a mask as often as possible so as not to endanger my upcoming vacation. A single positive test can already throw a spanner in the works.

sheep.title: If you would only obey, we would all be free
sheep.details: Those who oppose prescriptions and vaccinations are to blame for the situation not improving. If they obeyed, we would have overcome the crisis long ago and would be free again.

sheep.title: Vaccination not directly responsible
sheep.details: In people who suffer damage after vaccination, the cause is not the vaccination itself, but existing and undetected previous diseases. Often, an undetected corona infection is also the reason.

sheep.title: Do not want to lose my job
sheep.details: I don't agree with a lot of it either, but I can't help but follow the guidelines because I fear for my job. Not everyone can afford to take a critical stance.

sheep.title: I only follow my instructions
sheep.details: In my professional role, I cannot help but follow instructions from my employer or supervisor. Therefore, I cannot be held responsible for possible consequences and problems.

sheep.title: You do not know with many things what is in it
sheep.details: Lack of knowledge about ingredients does not only apply to vaccines. In general, no one can say with certainty what is contained in the foods and medications we consume every day.

sheep.title: Bogus correlation due to lack of data
sheep.details: Although mortality rates are partially correlated with vaccination rates, this correlation is only a spurious correlation. The available data cannot answer whether vaccinations have a positive or negative effect on deaths.

sheep.title: Does not give more heart attacks after vaccination
sheep.details: Statistically, the number of heart attacks has not increased. Claims that vaccination leads to increased heart problems and infarctions are not supported by the numbers.

sheep.title: Excess mortality has other causes
sheep.details: There are most likely other causes than the vaccination campaign for the excess mortality observed worldwide, such as the failure to treat many chronic diseases. Such false claims only put us all at risk.

sheep.title: Vaccine does not destroy the immune system
sheep.details: The assertion that the immune system is destroyed by vaccination is a dangerous misstatement that is not supported by any evidence. It makes people abandon the life-saving vaccinations.

sheep.title: No underreporting of vaccine injuries/deaths
sheep.details: A claimed high number of unreported cases of vaccination injuries and deaths is not supported by any evidence. Based on the existing reporting and backup procedures, it can be assumed that the majority of cases are reported correctly.

sheep.title: Was already sick before vaccination
sheep.details: People who fall ill with covid or other diseases after vaccination were often already ill before vaccination. In their case, it is not the vaccine side effects that are responsible, the disease would have broken out anyway.

sheep.title: Omicron is other kind of danger
sheep.details: With Omikron, the ratio of incidences to deaths is different, because it is less dangerous and much more contagious. However, this only means that the danger is different, not that it has been eliminated.

sheep.title: Omicron vaccine takes too long
sheep.details: It will simply take too long before a specific vaccine for the Omikron variant is ready for development. Until then, we are only protected with a vaccine that is not very effective, so caution is still the order of the day.

sheep.title: Deltacron-Variant
sheep.details: A new variant of the virus is spreading that combines the dangerousness of the Delta variant with the high rate of spread of the Omicron variant. Measures must again be taken against the spread of this variant.

sheep.title: How many are still protected?
sheep.details: Due to the decreasing effectiveness of vaccination and the many breakthroughs, it is not yet known how many of those vaccinated are still adequately protected. Unfortunately, the vaccination rate does not provide any precise information on this.

sheep.title: Covid should scare you more
sheep.details: It is irrational to avoid vaccination out of concern for side effects, since the disease with its long-term consequences is much more likely. One should be more concerned about the disease than the risk of a vaccination side effect.

sheep.title: Long Covid victims are not taken seriously
sheep.details: Many physicians and policymakers dismiss common Long Covid symptoms such as chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) as imaginary or not Covid-related. In this way, they try to distract from their risky easing policies.

sheep.title: Teasing someone about the mask is bullying
