sheep.details: People who continue to wear masks out of concern for their health despite the suspended mask requirement must be respected at all costs. Any kind of exclusion or disparagement of these people is bullying!

sheep.title: If from the lab, then an accident
sheep.details: If the laboratory origin of the virus was confirmed, its escape was almost certainly accidental and not a conspiracy. A deliberately released pest would have been much more deadly and sophisticated.

sheep.title: Wearing masks gives safety
sheep.details: Wearing masks gives people security and leads to lower psychological stress because people feel protected and thus have less fear of infection. Masks thus also indirectly ensure better health for everyone.

sheep.title: Rare allergic reactions treatable
sheep.details: The vaccination can cause an allergic reaction in rare cases, but this is easily treatable with an epipen. There is no reason to dismiss people from vaccination with reference to this risk.

sheep.title: Sick vaccinated only had bad luck
sheep.details: People who got sick covid despite the vaccination, just had bad luck. Such vaccine breakthroughs are possible, for example, due to individually less effective vaccination, but the fate of very few people.

sheep.title: Healthy unvaccinated people were just lucky
sheep.details: Unvaccinated persons who were spared infection or had only a mild course were simply lucky. No statement about the effectiveness of the vaccination can be derived from the existence of this group.

sheep.title: The Science is unequivocal
sheep.details: The science around corona control is clear and unequivocal. Therefore, there is no acceptable reason to doubt or avoid global vaccination as a key pandemic control measure.

sheep.title: Bill Gates is also vaccinated
sheep.details: Bill Gates, whom some see as the mastermind of a great Corona conspiracy, is himself vaccinated. He would not have himself and his children vaccinated if the vaccination represented what the critics claim.

sheep.title: Virus forces the measures
sheep.details: The virus in its spreading pattern simply forces measures such as lockdowns once a certain number of cases have been identified. Politicians, advised by experts, do nothing other than counteract this by imposing restrictions.

sheep.title: Vaccination critics see vaccination damage everywhere
sheep.details: In their assumption that vaccination makes people ill, vaccination critics interpret every event and symptom in their vaccinated environment as vaccine damage. In doing so, they completely disregard the fact that people always get sick sometimes.

sheep.title: Continue to wear the mask in solidarity
sheep.details: Even though the mask is no longer mandatory, I will continue to wear it to show solidarity. If even one person is spared from the fate of Covid in this way, the effort has already been worthwhile.

sheep.title: Some have it in the genes
sheep.details: If some people simply don't get infected or get covid, it's because of their good genetic makeup. However, one cannot assume that such a positive fate is given to all people.

sheep.title: No effect without side effect
sheep.details: With medicines, there are side effects, because what has no side effects has no effect. Therefore, the indignation of vaccinated people about their little problems is misplaced in the face of our great challenges.

sheep.title: Vaccination saves millions of lives
sheep.details: Vaccination has saved millions of lives worldwide and continues to save some, with a very small number of vaccine injuries. We continue to prevent almost all fatal outcomes by providing the vaccines.

sheep.title: Shall rejoice in freedom of expression
sheep.details: Anyone who now publishes and discusses the most outlandish theses in social media should be happy about this form of freedom of speech. However, free speech also means having to accept equally loud opposition.

sheep.title: Side effects are (mini-)long covid
sheep.details: What critics call side effects of vaccination are actually symptoms of mini Long Covid disease. Minor Long Covid symptoms can also develop after undetected or mild courses.

sheep.title: Errors in vaccination campaigns
sheep.details: Policymakers around the world have made many mistakes in distributing and rolling out vaccines, which have cost unnecessary casualties. To avoid repeating these mistakes, vaccination campaigns must be better organized in the future.

sheep.title: Spike protein is not the whole virus
sheep.details: Only a complete virus can force human cells to reproduce. In contrast, mRNA vaccination only ensures the production of harmless spike proteins, which themselves only activate the immune system and do not 'hijack' cells.

sheep.title: Snippet mRNA is harmless
sheep.details: The mRNA blueprint introduced into the body's cells via inoculation should not be scary because it only contains instructions for producing small spike proteins, not a full virus.

sheep.title: A viral infection proceeds exponentially
sheep.details: Vaccination is preferable to natural infection because viral infection means an exponentially growing glut of viruses that the immune system must fight off, but the vaccine does not take exponential development.

sheep.title: Booster vaccine is withheld
sheep.details: Because the vaccination effect wears off faster than desired, everyone should have access to timely booster vaccinations. While there is enough vaccine, it is unfortunately not yet made available for regular booster vaccinations.

sheep.title: Critical studies usually unserious
sheep.details: Studies critical of measures and vaccines are usually interest-driven and thus highly dubious. In this way, opponents of vaccination repeatedly try to give a scientific veneer to aberrant views.

sheep.title: Individual cases are not representative
sheep.details: Frequently cited anecdotal individual fates of vaccination side effects or even deaths are irrelevant, even if it is one's own fate. Only statistically clean surveys and evaluations can provide reliable data.

sheep.title: Expert conspiracy unrealistic
sheep.details: It is unrealistic that millions of experts of all relevant disciplines from partly hostile countries have conspired with each other to form Corona. Someone who believes this is hard to take seriously.

sheep.title: People can not handle information
sheep.details: The majority of people cannot cope with the amount of information and cannot classify the published figures. They now react to critical media reports with mistrust, but used to fully trust their doctor.

sheep.title: Prepare for the next winter
sheep.details: The next winter with a winter wave is coming in any case and we have to prepare for it better than before. Disease and death are best prevented by early vaccination and boosting - also of children.

sheep.title: "Since" is not the same as 'because'!
sheep.details: It is true that 'since' is not the same as 'because', i.e. corellation is not causality. In individual cases, it is very difficult to decide whether a supposed side effect is coincidental or causally related to the vaccination.

sheep.title: All self-proclaimed experts
sheep.details: Surveys repeatedly reveal a clear tendency to overestimate oneself, for example when a large majority considers itself to be of above-average intelligence. Of course, this is just as true for virological questions.

sheep.title: Vaccination victims would also have fallen ill in the same way
sheep.details: Anyone who has an allegedly life-threatening reaction to even a weak 'viral dose' of a vaccination would probably have become seriously ill in the event of an infection even without vaccination. Individual weakness must not be blamed on vaccination.

sheep.title: Side effects are normal with new drugs
sheep.details: New drugs often still show side effects, but these are gradually improved via further development of the vaccine. Side effects were unavoidable in this case in order to react quickly to the spread of the virus.

sheep.title: Severity of the side effect subjective
sheep.details: The term 'serious side effect' is defined objectively in scientific terms, but subjectively everyone understands it differently (e.g. a sore arm). This drives up the recorded side effect figures.

sheep.title: Doctors are obliged to report!
sheep.details: Physicians are required by law to report even the suspicion of harm beyond the usual extent of a vaccination reaction. They therefore do so even in the absence of a financial incentive.

sheep.title: There is sufficient open discourse
sheep.details: The Internet and media provide sufficient platforms for open discourse on vaccination and measures. To be taken seriously in this ager, more than an expression of opinion on false facts is required.

sheep.title: You can also report side effects yourself
sheep.details: Complaints that physicians do not report side effects to their patients can easily be offset by those affected making their own reports online. All that is needed is to make use of this option.

sheep.title: People believe charlatans
sheep.details: There is a multitude of charlatans who are also up to their mischief in the Corona environment. No matter how often they have been disproved, there are always people who believe them more than real doctors and scientists.

sheep.title: Facts do not help against diffuse fears
sheep.details: One of the difficulties with opponents of vaccination is that facts do not help against diffuse fears. Despite many information campaigns on vaccination, the fear of vaccination and imagined consequences will probably never be completely conquered.

sheep.title: Environmental degradation and pandemics
sheep.details: Viral diversity in animals is always looking for new hosts - Corona has succeeded in making the leap to humans. Every intervention in nature increases the risk of new pandemics, for example when wild animals come into contact with farm animals.

sheep.title: 0.6 vs. 0.5 percent in control group
sheep.details: Critics often cite the 0.6% serious health problems from the Pfizer pivotal study, but usually fail to mention that 0.5% serious health problems also occurred in the control group.

sheep.title: Alleged Schwab quote is not one
sheep.details: The quote "You will own nothing and be happy." is wrongly attributed to Klaus Schwab, but it actually comes from a Danish politician who used it years ago to describe an extreme vision of the "share economy" for the WEF.

sheep.title: Monkey pox shows pandemic threat
sheep.details: The current outbreak of monkeypox, although less dangerous, nevertheless shows the pandemic threat we all face. It is high time that experts worldwide agree on international pandemic protection mechanisms.

sheep.title: Vaccination bias
sheep.details: On closer investigation, many experts who are critical of vaccination are close to a clientele that has always been positioned against vaccination. Therefore, their arguments in favor of vaccination should be taken with a grain of salt.

sheep.title: BA.5-Variant in Portugal
sheep.details: In Portugal, the new Omicron variant BA.5 was able to spread because many Corona measures were lifted too early. Policymakers in other countries should learn from this effect and better maintain their measures.

sheep.title: Does not want monkey pox
sheep.details: I have no desire to be infected with monkeypox, so I expect politicians to act faster and better than before in the event of a new pandemic. And hopefully they will use the Corona experience to do so.

sheep.title: Media prefer negative reports
sheep.details: The media typically prefer negative and sensational news, as this serves to attract attention and thus their revenues. From this fact, however, one cannot deduce a controlled fear manipulation of the masses in the pandemic context.

sheep.title: Chain of infection in monkeypox unclear
sheep.details: In monkeypox, the chain of infection is usually traceable, but this is not the case with the current infections. There is a worrying possibility that the virus has changed its transmission characteristics.

sheep.title: Charlatans are dangerous
sheep.details: In the corona context, as in other areas, dangerous charlatans are active who promise victims success with alternative treatment methods. It is in the interest of the general public that the state puts a stop to them.

sheep.title: Who are 'them up there'?
sheep.details: Who are the ominous elites that have engineered this entire crisis and are controlling it from above? Anyone who speaks of central actors without being able to name them makes himself untrustworthy.

sheep.title: What about North Korea?
sheep.details: How can one explain the catastrophic Corona outbreak in North Korea, whose government has so far refused vaccinations? The country's situation shows that isolation alone is not enough to contain the pandemic.

sheep.title: No mass psychosis
sheep.details: The crisis is not a mass psychosis or 'formation'. Pseudo experts misused terms from psychology here. Such critics must not be given publicity.

sheep.title: Virus is imported again through travel
sheep.details: Although the virus situation is improving in the home country, the virus is imported again and again in new variants due to increasing worldwide travel. Politics must take the lead here through regulations.

sheep.title: SADS has always existed
sheep.details: The diagnosis of sudden, unexplained cardiac death has been around for a long time and has nothing to do with the current Corona situation or the vaccination campaigns. Corresponding claims with reference to statistical figures are misinformation.

sheep.title: Algorithms make extremists
sheep.details: Social media algorithms, typically designed to hold people, bring them into contact with increasingly extreme views in the Corona context. In the end, you end up irredeemably in the Telegram bubble.

sheep.title: Firmware update for the immune system
sheep.details: You can look at vaccinations like a firmware update for the immune system. If the old one still has errors, you simply add a new update with a booster and at some point everything works and the pandemic is overcome.

sheep.title: Is due to heat and climate change
sheep.details: Heart problems and infarctions can be explained by climate change, as excessive heat can overload the human body. Here, predisposed people who already carry certain heart disease risks become victims.

sheep.title: Is due to dehydration
sheep.details: Tromboses, heart problems, and heart attacks can often be explained by dehydration, as people typically do not drink enough. There are usually simpler explanations than claimed vaccine side effects.

sheep.title: Is due to the psychological stress
sheep.details: Heart problems and attacks in the pandemic era often have psychosomatic causes such as financial worries or additional stresses from home schooling. There are usually simpler explanations than claimed vaccine side effects.

sheep.title: Is due to solar storms
sheep.details: So-called solar storms, which occur in cycles, can not only cause technical malfunctions but also increase the risk of heart disease. This is another possible explanation for claimed vaccine side effects.

sheep.title: Is due to pollution
sheep.details: Pollution of air, water and soil is responsible for millions of deaths each year, manifesting as strokes, heart attacks or chronic heart disease. Some mistakenly see these as vaccine side effects.

sheep.title: Virtually the same vaccine
sheep.details: Vaccines adapted to new variants work according to the same procedure, only individual elements have been exchanged. Therefore, the abandonment of new licensing studies makes sense to get us out of the pandemic faster.

sheep.title: Preference for hearsay
sheep.details: Many people base their decisions on hearsay and second-hand information rather than on sound scientific data. This is not the way to get the dangerousness of the situation into people's heads via the media.

sheep.title: Why critical here in particular?
sheep.details: Hospital statistics showing high occupancy by multiple vaccinees are not evidence of ineffectiveness or harmfulness of vaccination, but rather an indication that there are many more vaccinated individuals in high-risk groups.

sheep.title: With freedom comes responsibility
sheep.details: With every freedom always comes a corresponding responsibility. The problem is that some people want one without the other, even though a balance between the two is the ideal for a society.

sheep.title: Tested and proven
sheep.details: Although the vaccines made available worldwide were developed and deployed in a very short time, it is now possible to infer from their successful use alone that they are tested and proven products.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated in hospital unfair
sheep.details: Not vaccinating yourself and then expecting the same care in case of illness as vaccinated people is unfair to the hospital staff. They are not only physically but also emotionally overburdened.

sheep.title: Vaccinated less dangerous for others
sheep.details: People who get vaccinated usually have only mild symptoms or none at all. Without symptoms, one has a lower viral load, hardly sneezes or coughs and thus hardly excretes the virus via aerosols or droplets.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated do not live long enough for studies
sheep.details: Studies showing overcrowding of hospitals with vaccinated individuals distort reality because unvaccinated individuals simply do not live long enough to still participate in this type of survey.

sheep.title: Simply signs of age
sheep.details: Difficulty climbing stairs and walking have nothing to do with vaccination (or Long Covid), but are simply an expected sign of aging. In old age, you can no longer expect so much from your body.

sheep.title: Simply a matter of conscience
sheep.details: My conscience simply won't allow me to violate distance, masking and social distancing rules. After all, you don't want to make your family, friends or people in general sick through negligent actions.

sheep.title: Access to vaccines a privilege
sheep.details: Early access to tested vaccines adapted to current virus variants is a great privilege reserved mainly for developed countries. Unfortunately, this awareness is not present among many.

sheep.title: Extremes lead to nothing good
sheep.details: To strive for extremes, e.g. the complete freedom of the individual, always leads to a deterioration for a society. It is always a matter of rational considerations that take into account human emancipation and solidarity.

sheep.title: Nuremberg Code abused
sheep.details: Critics of mass vaccination falsely place it in the context of the Nuremberg Code as a forced mass medical experiment. There can be no question of this in the case of an urgently needed and extensively tested vaccine.

sheep.title: False Balance Problem
sheep.details: When mass media attempt to reflect a diversity of opinions, a false balance quickly develops in which viewpoints appear more relevant to readers than they are. This is particularly common among Corona critics.

sheep.title: Abolish licensing bureaucracy
sheep.details: Progress in medicines worldwide is being held back by a regulatory bureaucracy. The use of medicines should simply be left to the free market and individual choice.

sheep.title: Safety rules are undermined
sheep.details: Protective structures are being undermined by an increasingly lax approach to safety rules, for example in public transportation or air travel. This puts people in danger and can also provoke new waves of disease.

sheep.title: More than a severe cold
sheep.details: Coronavirus infection is often mistakenly equated by critics with a severe cold. However, this virus is more dangerous because it has been shown to be more than just a cold symptom.

sheep.title: Vaccination reduces the risk of infection
sheep.details: A current vaccination does not protect 100% against infection, but the risk of infection is significantly reduced. Therefore, it is very useful to keep your vaccination status up to date as long as virus variants are still circulating.

sheep.title: Vaccination protects against severe courses
sheep.details: You can get sick even with the vaccination and even end up in the hospital, but it protects against severe courses. Therefore, it is very useful to update your vaccination regularly.

sheep.title: Vaccination reduces long covid risk
sheep.details: Although it is possible to get sick enough with vaccination to retain long covid symptoms, the risk of this is significantly reduced with vaccination. Therefore, up-to-date vaccination is desirable.

sheep.title: Omicron BQ.1.1
sheep.details: A new Omikron variant BG.1.1 spreads quickly and is both contagious like Omikron and dangerous like the Delta variant. Therefore, there is no other option than to impose comprehensive protective measures again.

sheep.title: Twindemic
sheep.details: With the Corona pandemic, influenza also poses a greater threat, for which, fortunately, there are up-to-date vaccines. We are threatened in the worst case by a Twindemic in winter, in which both Corona and influenza are rampant.

sheep.title: Studien-Cherrypicking
sheep.details: Critics sometimes support their positions with convincing studies, but this is mainly due to the fact that they select the most suitable papers. A balanced scientific approach would lead to completely different results.

sheep.title: Fortunately it was not Delta
sheep.details: I am very happy that I did contract Corona, but only the less dangerous Omicron variant, not the Delta variant that was present in the beginning. The evolution of the virus saved me.

sheep.title: Depression symptoms in many cases
sheep.details: There is a correlation between Long Covid symptoms and depression. Symptoms of depression such as listlessness, fatigue or concentration problems are sometimes wrongly interpreted as late effects of a covid infection.

sheep.title: More vaccinated people expected in hospital
sheep.details: The seemingly unusually high proportion of vaccinated people with covid in the hospital is actually expected, since the old and previously ill were vaccinated at a higher rate and are naturally more likely to end up there as high-risk patients.

sheep.title: From Corona denier to Putin fan
sheep.details: Many critics have seamlessly taken their aggressive ignorance of reality from the Corona topic to the Ukraine topic, and now they are also getting into trouble here with deviant views. After the anti-mainstream, you can already set the clock.

sheep.title: Mask less unpleasant than late effects
sheep.details: Wearing a mask temporarily on public transport, for example, is far less unpleasant than the potentially lifelong, agonizing consequences of an infection. I simply don't understand why the critics are so reluctant.

sheep.title: Boosters as a health routine
sheep.details: If you don't find the prospect of difficulty concentrating, aching muscles, joints and limbs, faintness and shortness of breath attractive, you should go for a booster as soon as possible. And let this booster become a health routine.

sheep.title: Standing before the era of pandemics
sheep.details: There will soon be combinations of different viruses, and infection with them would probably result in a high death rate. The probability of this is so high that we are threatened with a whole era of pandemics.

sheep.title: Sometimes glad about the mask requirement
sheep.details: I am sometimes glad that there is a mask requirement in certain places, e.g. in narrow waiting rooms or crowded public transport. That way I don't have to argue with other people about mutual protection.

sheep.title: I like to wear the mask
sheep.details: I now like to wear the mask because it gives me the good feeling of protecting my loved ones. It is still a comparatively unproblematic and easy to implement protection compared to other measures.

sheep.title: External protection is and was given
sheep.details: Although third-party protection through vaccination was not scientifically investigated at the beginning of the campaign, it can now be assumed as proven based on practical experience. Critics only inflate this aspect.

sheep.title: Excess mortality is still pandemic
sheep.details: The observed persistent global excess mortality can still be explained by the pandemic. In this case, people die from the longer-term after-effects of covid diseases that have already been overcome.

sheep.title: There is no glory in prevention
sheep.details: A preventive measure such as vaccination may not have any immediate benefit for the individual, but in its totality it helps the community. Unfortunately, this is difficult to communicate and many people are not understanding.

sheep.title: Critics trigger fear and illness
sheep.details: Critics who constantly bring up the very rare deaths and side effects of vaccinations trigger fears in their vaccinated communication partners that can themselves become pathological and trigger real illnesses!

sheep.title: Any infection carries long covid risk
sheep.details: In general, even after vaccination, any corona infection carries risks for long-term damage. Therefore, it makes sense to prevent infections. And thus also to maintain measures such as mandatory masks for a long time to come.

sheep.title: Vaccination rate shows level of education
sheep.details: The vaccination rate in a country or even a specific population group is a direct indicator of the educational level of the group. The higher it is, the more people have opted for vaccinations and also for boosters.

sheep.title: Critics believe in voodoo
sheep.details: During the pandemic, unfortunately, many people think they know better than science. They rely on treatment with substances and procedures that are more reminiscent of voodoo than sensible medical measures.

sheep.title: There is no listening requirement
sheep.details: Prominent critics complain about restricted freedom of speech because they do not appear in media reports or are not invited on talk shows. In doing so, they overlook the fact that freedom of speech by no means implies an obligation to listen.

sheep.title: Hanlon's razor blade
sheep.details: Even in the Corona context, Hanlon's razor blade usually applies, according to which one should never attribute to malice that which can also be adequately explained by stupidity.

sheep.title: Spikes only for a short time
sheep.details: The spike molecules are only produced in the body for a short time after the mRNA vaccine is injected, in order to stimulate the immune system to build antibodies. Side effects can therefore also only occur during this short period.

sheep.title: Antibody therapies not at Omikron
sheep.details: Preventive antibody therapies against coronavirus have little effect in Omikron. This is due to the progressive development of resistance to the virus, against which new forms of therapy must be researched.

sheep.title: Baby boom and not birth slump
sheep.details: The critics' claim that vaccination leads to infertility and thus to a decline in births has not been confirmed in many countries. Instead, a baby boom can even be observed in many places.

sheep.title: CDS is corrosive and dangerous
sheep.details: Chlorine dioxide solution (CDS), considered by many critics to be a miracle cure for treating infections, is actually dangerous. It can cause harm such as chemical burns, depending on how it is made or used.

sheep.title: Sudden death not an issue in the past
sheep.details: News about sudden deaths is spread only for self-affirmation or to generate clicks. There used to be such deaths too, but news about them just didn't get out to the public.

sheep.title: Has nothing to do with vaccination
sheep.details: The susceptibility of many people to disease can be traced back to an immune deficiency after having undergone corona infection. It therefore has nothing to do with vaccination, although this is repeatedly claimed.

sheep.title: Trolls controlled from Russia
sheep.details: The Russian government is generally interested in sabotaging and dividing Western societies with its propaganda. This also applies to the Corona issue, where a lot of misinformation is distributed through Russian channels.

sheep.title: Unvaccinated split (themselves)
sheep.details: People who refuse to be vaccinated are dividing society by splitting themselves off from the majority. In this respect, the narrative of a split from above by politics is not true - and the critics are not victims.

sheep.title: Not a private matter
sheep.details: Refusal to vaccinate causes burdens for the general public. In this respect, it is not a private matter if people do not get vaccinated, just as the discharge of wastewater is not a private matter for the factory owner.

sheep.title: Excess mortality is Long Covid
sheep.details: The observed worldwide excess mortality is not due to vaccination side effects, but to the fact that many people still suffer and die from long-covid. These numbers will decline after the end of the pandemic.

sheep.title: Politicians want to change the world
sheep.details: It is not true that today's politicians are built up in cadre schools as puppets of powerful people. You go into politics out of conviction - to improve the world - not because you want to serve rich people.

sheep.title: Excess mortality depends on vaccination rate
sheep.details: In a global comparison, excess mortality shows a direct correlation with the vaccination rate. The more people in a country are sufficiently vaccinated, the lower the excess mortality. This also proves the effectiveness of vaccination.

sheep.title: How does the Bluetooth transmitter get into the syringe?
sheep.details: If, as many critics claim, one is to become a Bluetooth transmitter as a vaccinated person, how does exactly one Bluetooth receiver from the vaccine vial get into each syringe? That is technically impossible and also not comprehensible.

sheep.title: Media very self-critical
sheep.details: Our mass media are following the political decisions during the Corona crisis very critically and are taking a very self-critical look at their own work. And much more so than the alternative media in the critics' bubble.

sheep.title: Chinese envy us the vaccines
sheep.details: The Chinese population envies our highly effective vaccines in the Western nations. Western vaccines are not very widespread there, and China simply cannot get out of the pandemic with its own, less effective ones.

sheep.title: Tracking now impossible
sheep.details: Because China has had to back away from its strict corona policy, tracking corona disease in the population is no longer possible. The Chinese health policy has failed and this has implications for the whole world.

sheep.title: China's Covid Policy Seems Excessive
sheep.details: China's restrictive no-covid policy with constant tests and quarantine warehouses seems excessive. However, that is still no reason to demand that we abandon all measures.

sheep.title: China's vaccines are too poor
sheep.details: The vaccines produced in China have much lower efficacy, forcing the country to adopt a no-covid policy and thus continued severe restrictions on the population.

sheep.title: U-turn in China tricky
sheep.details: The u-turn in the Chinese government's covid policy, is tricky given China's low vaccination and thus immunity rates. By scaling back the measures, the virus will spread exponentially again.

sheep.title: Omikron XBB.1.5
sheep.details: A new variant spreads faster worldwide than other variants because it is a recombianation of two variants. It seems that this variant is especially problematic for vaccinated people.

sheep.title: Media only want sensations
sheep.details: The reporting of the mass media can be explained by their tendency to want to generate clicks and thus sales with sensational news. There are no malicious intentions behind this, such as wanting to divide the population or instill fear.

sheep.title: Chinese workers in Bergamo
sheep.details: Bergamo as the first Corona hotspot is very understandable. In northern Italy, a great many Chinese work in the textile industry, in a very confined space. They have "flown in" the virus via the usual Chinese New Year travel wave.

sheep.title: Excess mortality is flu wave
sheep.details: Part of the unusually high excess mortality can be explained by a strong flu epidemic. Flu viruses can spread easily due to the immunocompromised population caused by Corona and are not infrequently fatal.

sheep.title: Risk groups more likely to be vaccinated
sheep.details: Hospital statistics showing high occupancy by multiple vaccinees are not evidence of ineffectiveness or harmfulness of vaccination, but rather an indication that there are many more vaccinated individuals in high-risk groups.

sheep.title: No flu because Covid vaccination also effective there
sheep.details: The statistical absence of influenza cases during the pandemic can be explained by the fact that the Covid vaccine is also effective against influenza. A claimed redefinition of flu cases as Covid has not occurred.

sheep.title: Lost respect for the virus
sheep.details: A major problem is that as the restrictions fall, people quickly lose respect for the virus and behave carelessly. As a result, a new wave of the virus can quickly lead to another outbreak.

sheep.title: Explainable with sensationalism
sheep.details: The panic media coverage of Covid can be explained solely by the fact that the news cycle constantly demands sensational stories and the measurement of success is by clicks rather than accuracy and clean research.

sheep.title: Intensive care units empty after vaccination
sheep.details: Clear evidence that vaccination has definitely had a positive impact on corona incidence is the fact that intensive care units emptied after major corona vaccination campaigns.

sheep.title: Mainly young men on ITS
sheep.details: Just how dangerous the virus was can be seen from the fact that a disproportionate number of young men ended up in intensive care during the strong outbreaks.

sheep.title: Death after vaccination statistically normal
sheep.details: The fact that during a large vaccination campaign some people die for other reasons after their vaccination is purely statistically normal. Just because two events coincide does not make them cause and effect.

sheep.title: Benefits outweigh side effects
sheep.details: While it appears that there are more severe vaccine side effects and deaths than expected, the benefits of vaccination still outweigh the risks. Without vaccination, there would have been significantly more Corona victims.

sheep.title: Cyberchondria
sheep.details: Side effects and problems after vaccination often arise due to a new form of hypochondria, so-called cyberchondria. The source is the Internet, which leads victims to self-diagnosis, which then becomes the real disease.

sheep.title: Dissolution of the control group was mandatory
sheep.details: The premature dissolution of the control group in the long-term study on Corona vaccination had to be done for ethical reasons: One could not deprive the control group of the effective vaccination, because that would be tantamount to human experimentation.

sheep.title: Transfer from tanuki
sheep.details: Transmission of the virus to humans in the form of a zoonosis is still more likely than the laboratory hypothesis. The tanuki is also a possible intermediate host as a vector.

sheep.title: Hybrid immunity
sheep.details: Previous infection together with vaccination leads to a so-called hybrid immunity against Corona, i.e. a strengthened immunological memory that provides better protection against the virus.

sheep.title: Also comply with senseless rules
sheep.details: Many rules that existed during and after the pandemic are more or less meaningless. But following rules is a sensible foundation of our civilization and is there to avoid chaos.

sheep.title: Failure to test falsifies pandemic
sheep.details: The declining number of documented infections comes from the sharp decline in testing. The number of covid cases remains high and currently many people continue to die daily from corona.

sheep.title: After the pandemic is before the pandemic
sheep.details: This pandemic has been overcome, but the next one is sure to come. We must take better precautions for this one and also lay down binding rules for everyone on how to deal with it.

sheep.title: China ist intransparent
sheep.details: The search for the virus origin - wild animal market or laboratory mishap - can only be successful with data from China. Only through their still pending release can further research be conducted.
